purpose: Turn the additive R18-R28 LPC intake authority into visible, honest native-editor catalog exposure without treating unbound source art as runtime-ready placeables.

worldSourceBrowser.rawArtPolicy: Raw LPC images remain in the verified machine-local LPC mount and are thumbnail-loaded lazily.
worldSourceBrowser.placementPolicy: SourceReference cards are searchable/favoriteable/recent-visible but cannot paint/place until promoted to a semantic/runtime binding.

characterStudio.rule: The two sections partition the shared Universal LPC character-builder categories; they do not create a second character catalog.

gameMirror.label: Wardrobe & Gear
gameMirror.rule: Character Studio and the game expose different-depth views of the same gameplay equipment concepts; the editor must not invent an editor-only equipment truth.

acceptance: All Project Asset Browser exposes hundreds of LPC source-reference cards in addition to runtime-ready assets.
Mouse wheel scrolls the visible asset-card grid; the four-card Prev/Next pagination is gone.
Source cards show exact LPC thumbnails when the pinned source mount is available.
Source cards clearly report Needs Binding and cannot be dragged onto the world as fake runtime objects.
Character Studio has Create and Wardrobe & Gear sections while retaining exact ULPC definition-driven composition.
The game inventory presents its equipment surface as Wardrobe & Gear rather than an unrelated editor-only concept.
